audience: podcasters who publish their show on RSS.com and manage episodes from an AI client

useCases.title: Review episodes by status
useCases.text: List the podcasts on the account, then the episodes of one podcast, filtered by draft, scheduled or published. Open an episode to see its schedule and processing state.

useCases.title: Draft an episode with notes and keywords
useCases.text: Create one draft episode, then edit its notes and fields. Use keyword ids from the podcast's keyword list. Nothing publishes until a schedule is set.

useCases.title: Add chapters and soundbites to an episode
useCases.text: List the chapters of an episode, then add one with its start time and duration in milliseconds. Add soundbite clips the same way.

useCases.title: Publish an episode when its audio is ready
useCases.text: Set the publish schedule of an episode. With no time set, it publishes as soon as transcoding finishes. Unschedule it to stop the publish.

useCases.title: Generate or save a transcript
useCases.text: Start automatic transcript generation from the audio, as VTT or SRT. Or save a transcript text you wrote yourself, which replaces the old one.
